title: Talent Acquisition Business Partner
description:
ADP is hiring an experienced Talent Acquisition Business Partner in Sao Paulo office. In this position, you'll attract top talent to ADP by implementing best practices in recruiting strategy. You'll create, roll out, and execute complex recruiting projects to deliver meaningful results for Latin America region.


Unlock Your Career Potential: Talent Acquisition at ADP. You make it happen by collaborating with internal ADP Leaders and Associates to ensure our products and services deliver winning results. You provide the key talent that develops, designs, and markets our integrated solutions in an increasingly competitive global marketplace.


What You'll Do to Drive the Process

  • Drive implementation and execution of best practices in behavioral based interviewing and recruiting strategy
  • Put your agility and time management skills to work while managing large and/or complex req. volumes and using the Full Cycle recruiting process: sourcing, screening, evaluating, and completing hiring process

Be a Talent Magnet

  • Proactively uncover and implement creative ways to identify and recruit top talent
  • Use social media platforms to connect with talent pools

Be a trusted advisor to stakeholders

  • Identify client needs, provide expertise, and drive staffing strategy in client consultation
  • Innovate processes and strategies that provide the most effective staffing experience for stakeholders

Obsess Over the Candidate Experience

  • Provide a five-star candidate experience that is positive, simplified, and memorable
  • Sell ADP's Employer Brand and culture to potential candidates

Deliver Meaningful Results

  • Launch and deliver on key hiring initiatives that make an impact and drive the success of the overall ADP organization
  • Make a difference and partner with talent leaders in functional areas by supporting the people, development, and growth of various internal organizations

What You Need To Do The Job (Education/Experience/Critical Skills)

  • Bilingual, English & Portuguese. Spanish is a plus!
  • 3 years +/- Full Cycle Recruitment Experience or other relevant experience in HR.
  • A top-notch track record of meeting and exceeding KPIs, managing large or complex vacancy volumes, and executing projects with excellence.
  • Interest in working on employer branding.
  • Experience partnering with leadership and driving hiring initiatives.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, along with the ability to interact at all levels of an organization.
  • Knowledge of local employment law (Brazil).
  • Demonstrated ability to multi-task, manage multiple deadlines, oversee projects, influence without authority, and drive for desired results.

title: 维修技术员
description:
We are a leading B2B electronic equipment manufacturer, specializing in providing high-performance inverters and power solutions for the global industrial and new energy sectors. We are committed to technological innovation and excellent customer service. Join us, and you will have the opportunity to learn cutting-edge repair technologies in a fast-growing industry and gain a clear career development path.

Somos um fabricante líder de equipamentos eletrônicos B2B, especializados no fornecimento de inversores e soluções de energia de alto desempenho para os setores industrial e de novas energias globais. Estamos comprometidos com a inovação tecnológica e com um excelente serviço ao cliente. Junte-se a nós e você terá a oportunidade de aprender tecnologias de reparo de ponta em um setor em rápido crescimento e obter um caminho de desenvolvimento de carreira claro.


Job Responsibility/Responsabilidades Principais

As a Junior Inverter Repair Technician, you will be responsible for the routine diagnosis, repair, and testing of the company's inverter products within the factory repair center. This is a critical role in our after-sales service system, aimed at ensuring high product quality and customer satisfaction. We welcome recent graduates or enthusiastic candidates with a college diploma in Electronics or a related field, and no prior experience is required.

Como Técnico de Reparação de Inversores Júnior, você será responsável pelo diagnóstico de rotina, reparo e teste dos inversores de frequência fabricados pela empresa, dentro do centro de reparos da fábrica. Esta função é uma parte essencial do nosso sistema de serviço pós-venda, visando garantir a alta qualidade do produto e a satisfação do cliente. Aceitamos recém-formados ou candidatos entusiastas com diploma universitário em Eletrônica ou área relacionada, sendo que a experiência prévia não é obrigatória.


Qualifications/Requisitos

  1. College Diploma or above/Diploma Universitário ou superior
  2. Electronics Engineering, Electrical Automation, Mechatronics, or related fields/Engenharia Eletrônica, Automação Elétrica, Mecatrônica ou áreas relacionadas
  3. No experience required, outstanding fresh graduates are welcome/Experiência não obrigatória, excelentes recém-formados são bem-vindos

title: NGS Scientific & Technical Operations Manager – LATAM
description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY



MGI is at the forefront of genomics innovation, delivering cutting-edge sequencing technologies and advancing life sciences research worldwide. We are dedicated to enabling affordable, effective healthcare solutions and expanding our impact across the Americas. If you’re passionate about genomics, NGS, and making a real difference in healthcare and research, join us on this exciting journey toward accessible innovation for all.



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are seeking an experienced NGS Scientific & Technical Operations Manager – LATAM to lead our Scientists, Field Service Engineers, Bioinformatics, Quality, and Customer Experience teams across Latin America. This leadership role requires a solid scientific foundation in molecular biology, genetics, bioinformatics, or related life sciences, combined with strong operational and people management skills. You will ensure exceptional customer support, technical excellence, and continuous improvement across all post-sales service functions in the region.



RESPONSIBILITIES



  • Report directly to the Head of LATAM and collaborate closely with Global Technical Support, Training, Sales, and Service Operations leaders.
  • Lead and mentor a multidisciplinary team including Field Application Scientists, Field Service Engineers, Field Bioinformaticians, and Customer Support professionals.
  • Oversee customer satisfaction and operational efficiency, ensuring that service requests, installations, and technical issues are managed effectively and within expected timelines.
  • Define individual training and development needs across the technical team and recommend staffing plans and hiring strategies.
  • Establish measurable goals and performance indicators (e.g., response time, first-time resolution, quality metrics).
  • Manage regional service operations including resource allocation, travel budgets, spare part inventory, and field reporting.
  • Ensure accurate communication and coordination between LATAM and global operations, cascading critical updates and initiatives.
  • Serve as the technical and operational lead for the Customer Experience Center (CEC) and Demo Lab, driving technical demonstrations and customer engagement.
  • Maintain alignment with global quality standards, ensuring compliance, traceability, and continuous improvement of support processes.

title: Tech Lead (Conversational Solutions)
description:
Sinch is at the forefront of transforming customer communications, offering innovative solutions that empower businesses around the globe. We are looking for a Tech Lead specializing in Conversational Solutions to guide our talented engineers and help shape our cutting-edge platforms.

In this role, you will be instrumental in developing and enhancing our conversational AI solutions, integrating advanced technologies such as NLP and machine learning to deliver exceptional user experiences.



Responsibilities

  • Lead the development of conversational solutions, including chatbots and voice initiatives, ensuring alignment with business goals and customer needs.
  • Architect and design scalable systems that can handle real-time interactions and integrate various channels of communication.
  • Guide and mentor a team of engineers, promoting best practices and innovation in software development.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and stakeholders to refine requirements and deliver high-quality products.
  • Stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies in conversational AI and incorporate relevant advancements into Sinch's offerings.
  • Ensure robust testing and deployment processes, maintaining high standards of code quality and system reliability.
  • Actively contribute to the team's success by driving initiatives, providing technical guidance, and fostering a collaborative environment.



Requirements

  • Experience performing as technical lead of Software Development team.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Solid experience in software development, with a strong focus on AI and conversational solutions.
  • Expertise in programming Low Code (Dialogue Flow, IBM Watson), NodeJS, JavaScript, Golang ou outras linguagens microsservices
  • Experience with NLP technologies and frameworks (e.g., Rasa, Dialogflow, or similar).
  • Strong understanding of microservices, cloud technologies (AWS, GCP, Azure), and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Proven experience in leading technical teams, mentoring engineers, and driving collaborative projects.
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills and a passion for developing innovative solutions.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Our corporate language is English, please submit your application in English
  • Experience with real-time messaging platforms and API integrations.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD practices and tools.
  • Familiarity with agile development methodologies and project management tools.



Benefits

Sinch is a global company composed of people from different countries and cultures. Our benefits adjust regionally to support employees and help them to thrive in every stage of life. We offer valuable benefits and resources, including health and life insurance, a flexible work environment, retirement savings plans, and more.


  • STAY HEALTHY: We cover 100% of medical and dental plans for Sinchers and eligible dependents through Bradesco Saúde.
  • FLEXIBLE BENEFITS: With the Caju flexible benefit card, our Sinchers can choose to use benefits on food, education, and home office assistance.
  • FAMILY FIRST: Our Sinchers can enjoy paid maternity leave for 180 days and paternity leave for 30 days. Plus, we provide daycare assistance for kids up to five years old.
  • EVERYDAY WELLBEING: We partner with Wellhub to help Sinchers access gyms and wellness options.
  • SECURE YOUR FUTURE: Our Partnership with Prudential life insurance provides coverage for all Sinchers in the events of unexpected absences, serious illness, accidents, and disabilities.
  • DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION: We offer annual reimbursements for certain expenses related to disabilities and/or transgender needs.
  • TAKE A BREAK: Our Sinchers can take a day off on their birthday to celebrate with their loved ones.


Our Hiring Process

In Sinch, we are committed to following a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and non-discriminatory. Our Talent Acquisition team, together with hiring managers and the rest of the interviewing team, persistently work towards identifying the candidates that best fit each open job, based on Sinch' s hiring needs and candidates' career expectations. We encourage applications from strong candidates with relevant professional backgrounds for this role. Not all applicants will meet all job requirements exactly! Even if you do not meet all job requirements, don't let that stop you from considering Sinch for the next step in your career. We are always open to candidates that could bring new ideas and perspectives to Sinch!

title: Gerente de ventas trilingue (Español, Inglés, Portugués)
description:
El supervisor de ventas (Gerente de Ventas) es responsable de supervisar la gestión de los equipos que dan soporte a las cuentas para impulsar la generación de ingresos y el crecimiento del negocio, liderar un equipo de ventas, ser responsable de impulsar el rendimiento del equipo a través de acciones de éxito del cliente (integración, adopción, verificaciones de integridad y voz del cliente) y/o acciones de retención de ingresos (renovaciones de contratos de productos/servicios, ampliación, ventas adicionales y expansión). Objetivo del puesto:

Supervisar y orientar a un equipo de asociados de adquisición de clientes para alcanzar los objetivos de ventas de la empresa en el ámbito B2B de paises de LATAM (en español). Esto implica planificación estratégica, orientación y apoyo directo para garantizar el éxito del equipo.


Sus responsabilidades:

  • Dirigir, capacitar y orientar a un equipo de asociados enfocado en la adquisición de nuevos clientes empresariales en LATAM (paises que hablan español).

Requisitos:

  • Más de tres años de experiencia demostrable en un puesto de ventas.
  • Es importante contar con más de 1 año de experiencia en liderazgo en un puesto similar en ventas.
  • Sólidos conocimientos de la dinámica del mercado de paises de LATAM (que hablan español), especialmente en el sector de las redes sociales y la tecnología.
  • Dominio del español y el inglés (B2+/C1), con excelentes habilidades de comunicación y liderazgo.

  • Vale-transporte

title: Product Designer - Sênior
description:
PRODUCT DESIGNER

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Como Product Designer, você será responsável por conduzir processos de Discovery e Design de Experiência, transformando problemas complexos em soluções intuitivas, consistentes e centradas no usuário. Sua missão será conectar estratégia, dados e usabilidade para desenhar produtos digitais que gerem impacto real para o negócio e para as pessoas.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Conduzir processos de Discovery, aplicando metodologias como benchmark, canvas, pesquisas com usuários, testes de usabilidade, análises heurísticas e hierarquia da informação para propor e definir jornadas consistentes;
  • Criar o layout de fluxos de navegação e comunicações a serem apresentados no site, desenhar wireframes, protótipos interativos e interfaces visuais responsiva;
  • Garantir consistência visual, de informação e de usabilidade em todos os produtos digitais;
  • Participar de agendas colaborativas com times de produto, tecnologia e dados, alinhando objetivos estratégicos;
  • Contribuir para a evolução e manutenção do design system da empresa.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência comprovada como UX/UI Designer, com portfólio relevante;
  • Domínio de ferramentas como Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch ou similares;
  • Conhecimento em Design Thinking, Lean UX e metodologias centradas no usuário;
  • Familiaridade com princípios de acessibilidade e design inclusivo;
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar dados e traduzir insights em soluções de design;
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade de colaboração com times multidisciplinares;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação híbrida em São Paulo/SP.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Já tiver atuado com metodologias ágeis;
  • Tiver experiência com gerenciadores de tarefas;
  • Já tiver atuado em consultoria ou prestação de serviços;
  • Tiver perfil analítico, organizado e propositivo, com autogestão e foco em qualidade das entregas.

O que oferecemos aos nossos Rethinkers?


Básico que a gente ama

  • Cartão Caju para usar como quiser nos benefícios de alimentação e home office
  • Day-off no aniversário
  • Kit de onboarding com todas as ferramentas essenciais e mimos exclusivos para Rethinkers


Saúde e bem-estar

  • Auxílio bem-estar mensal
  • Convênio médico Bradesco (100% custeado pela Rethink, com cobertura nacional)
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Saúde mental com a plataforma Conexa Saúde
  • Wellhub para cuidar do corpo em movimento
  • On Happy para planejar suas viagens à lazer
  • Escritórios em Belo Horizonte e Ipatinga prontos para te receber


Carreira e desenvolvimento

  • Plataforma interna com cursos de hard e soft skills
  • Oportunidades reais de crescimento em um ambiente que valoriza o aprendizado contínuo

Como funciona o nosso processo seletivo?

  1. Inscrição
  2. Você começa sua jornada cadastrando seu perfil por aqui.
  3. Bate-papo com People
  4. Uma conversa leve para conhecermos você, sua história e seus objetivos — e te apresentarmos nossa cultura.
  5. Entrevista técnica com liderança
  6. Hora de mergulhar nas suas habilidades e experiências.
  7. Feedback final
  8. Independente do resultado, você receberá um retorno e os próximos passos serão alinhados com transparência.

Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Coordenador(a) de Contabilidade
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Coordenador(a) de Contabilidade para atuar de forma estratégica e técnica, contribuindo para a gestão das rotinas contábeis e o fortalecimento dos processos financeiros da empresa.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

  • Coordenar as rotinas da área contábil, garantindo a correta execução de lançamentos, conciliações, provisões e depreciações;
  • Garantir o cumprimento dos fechamentos contábeis mensais, trimestrais e anuais dentro dos prazos e padrões estabelecidos;
  • Atuar no atendimento às auditorias internas e externas, assegurando a entrega de informações precisas e tempestivas;
  • Elaborar e revisar as Demonstrações Financeiras (Balanço Patrimonial, DRE e Notas Explicativas), assegurando conformidade com as normas contábeis vigentes;
  • Desenvolver e acompanhar indicadores (KPIs) e relatórios gerenciais que apoiem a tomada de decisão;
  • Participar de projetos de melhoria contínua e eficiência operacional , promovendo inovação e otimização de processos;
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico da equipe, fomentando boas práticas e padronização dos procedimentos contábeis.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Formação superior completa em Ciências Contábeis (registro ativo no CRC será considerado diferencial);
  • Experiência sólida na área contábil, com atuação prévia em posições de nível sênior ou de coordenação;
  • Forte raciocínio analítico , atenção aos detalhes e capacidade de organização;
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade de relacionamento interpessoal ;
  • Domínio do Pacote Office (principalmente Excel, Outlook e PowerPoint);
  • Conhecimento em sistemas ERP como SAP B1, Benner ou Alvo será considerado um diferencial.

title: Senior Business Continuity Analyst (BCM)
description:
Purpose of the Position

An Asian financial institution, recognized as one of the largest and among the leading banks worldwide, with a strong presence across the Americas, Europe, and Asia. In Brazil, the institution focuses on corporate and investment banking, providing clients with tailored financial solutions.


With a global reputation for stability and long-term relationships, the institution continues to invest in innovation, cybersecurity, and sustainability, reinforcing its commitment to responsible growth and the protection of client interests in a rapidly evolving financial landscape.


The main idea of this role is to protect the institution’s ability to deliver critical banking services during disruption by owning and advancing the BCM – Business Continuity Management program processes. This is a hands-on, orchestration-heavy position that translates global continuity standards into effective local execution and audit-ready evidence.

Concretely, the role:

  • Leads the BCM lifecycle end-to-end: conducts BIAs (criticality, dependencies, RTO/RPO), maintains BCPs, and plans/coordinates tests (e.g., DR/switch-over validations, contingency site, VDI/endpoint readiness, evacuation drills, call tree), including out-of-hours windows.
  • Turns results into decisions: surfaces risks, residual exposures, and disclaimers to risk committees; drives lessons learned and closes open issues with robust documentation and owners/dates/evidence.
  • Connects BCM to the broader non-financial risk picture: interfaces with Operational Incidents, Vendor Risk, Products & Services, and RCSA so that continuity risks and control gaps are consistently identified, tracked, and remediated.
  • Bridges global and local: adapts global policy/standards to Brazil’s context, ensuring regulatory fit (BACEN) without diluting control integrity.
  • Influences without formal authority: engages senior stakeholders (e.g., Treasury and Operations leaders) to prioritize continuity activities, align on test windows, and validate outcomes; partners with IT/IS to validate DR without performing technical changes.


Main Challenges and Assignments

  • Operate the existing Business Continuity framework while continuously improving its maturity, expanding coverage, and strengthening evidence quality.
  • Organize and document activities using spreadsheets and manual controls, ensuring that all records are audit-ready and compliant with internal and external requirements.
  • Plan, coordinate, and lead continuity tests, including out-of-hours exercises, anticipating risks, resolving issues on the spot, and making sound, well-reasoned decisions.
  • Adapt global policies and methodologies to the Brazilian regulatory context, maintaining alignment with global standards and full compliance with BACEN requirements.
  • Engage and influence critical business areas, such as Treasury and Operations, to secure collaboration and prioritization of BCM activities without direct authority.
  • Map critical processes, conduct Business Impact Analyses (BIA), and maintain updated Business Continuity Plans (BCP).
  • Develop, update, and review continuity policies, standards, and procedures, while supporting the management of open issues, regulatory requirements, and action plans.
  • Deliver training to teams and managers on continuity and disaster recovery procedures, proactively monitor external events and news for potential risks
  • This role will also involve executing other operational risk programs such as Operational Incident Management, Vendor/Product & Service Risk Management, etc.


Experience and Professional Qualifications

  • Bring solid experience gained over several years in financial institutions, with a proven track record in Business Continuity Management, including BIA, BCP, and continuity testing.
  • Demonstrate strong knowledge of operational resilience practices, with exposure to RCSA, operational incident management, and vendor/third-party risk.
  • Be comfortable coordinating with IT and Information Security (IS) teams during disaster recovery validations, leading and validating outcomes without performing the technical execution.
  • Possess proficiency in Excel for data analysis and tracking, and PowerPoint for building clear, executive-level presentations and reports.
  • Communicate effectively in English at a level to interact with global stakeholders and follow corporate standards.
  • Hold a degree in Business, Engineering, Information Systems/Computer Science, Risk Management, or a related field.
  • Knowledge of Bank Policies and Regulations, familiarity with cyber risk policies, procedures, and regulations, and the ability to review and ensure compliance with these requirements (Differential). Bring additional exposure to ISO 22301 standards, experience with tools such as Visio or Power BI/Power Query, and professional certifications in business continuity or disaster recovery (e.g., CBCP, DRII, BRCCI). (Differential)


Behavioral Skills

  • Executive communication & influence – Engages effectively with senior stakeholders, articulates complex topics in a clear, concise manner, and secures alignment in risk committees.
  • Proactivity & ownership – Demonstrates a self-starter mindset, acting hands-on and taking full responsibility for driving initiatives to completion.
  • Organization, discipline & critical thinking – Maintains audit-ready documentation with rigor and structure, while applying analytical thinking and sound judgment to make timely, well-reasoned decisions.
  • Collaboration & resilience – Partners seamlessly with Non-Tech areas and IT/IS, showing adaptability and composure under pressure, and adjusting course when unexpected challenges arise.


SE#

title: Analista de Digital Analytics – Tagueamento e Integração de Dados
description:
Sobre a Empresa:

A Atos é líder mundial em transformação digital, oferecendo serviços de transação de alta tecnologia, consultoria, integração de sistemas, cloud e serviços gerenciados. Além disso, anunciada como parceira mundial de TI nos Jogos Olímpicos e Paraolímpicos!


Presente em mais de 70 países e com aproximadamente 100.000 especialistas ao redor do mundo, nossa empresa está no novo ranking Digital 100 da Forbes, uma lista das principais empresas de capital aberto que moldam o mundo digital nas áreas de Tecnologia da Informação (TI), hardware, mídia, e-commerce e telecomunicações.


  • Híbrido na Zona Oeste de São Paulo/SP - até 2x na semana


Vaga: Analista Digital Analytics & Tagueamento


Descrição da Vaga:

Profissional para atuar na condução de implementações e soluções técnicas de Analytics nos nossos ambientes digitais (web e app), com foco em tagueamento e integração de ferramentas de medição. O profissional será responsável por atuar e orientar equipes em implementações de SDKs, bibliotecas de Analytics e tags, além de planejar as atividades técnicas relacionadas à coleta de dados para atender os requisitos dos times de negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Implementar tagueamento em ambientes web e app.
  • Orientar desenvolvedores na integração de SDKs (Firebase, AppsFlyer), bibliotecas de Analytics e tags do Google Analytics.
  • Planejar e gerenciar as atividades técnicas relacionadas ao Analytics.
  • Configurar e otimizar Google Analytics, AppsFlyer e Firebase (Custom Dimensions, Custom Metrics, Goals, integração com mídia, entre outros).
  • Especificar e implementar tags dentro do Google Tag Manager.
  • Criar mapas de eventos e garantir a medição alinhada aos objetivos de negócio.
  • Realizar homologação de tagueamento e capacitar o time de QA.
  • Desenvolver e manter a camada de dados (dataLayer) para garantir a integridade da coleta de dados.
  • Auxiliar no Quality Assurance dos dados coletados em nossos canais digitais (web/app).
  • Documentar processos técnicos e criar wikis para compartilhamento de boas práticas.
  • Capacitar e treinar o time nas melhores práticas de Digital Analytics.
  • Acompanhar e implementar inovações tecnológicas em soluções de Web Analytics, como Server Side Tagging e GA4.
  • Colaborar no mapeamento e arquitetura de dados, com foco na implementação técnica de coleta de dados considerando as necessidades do negócio.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência em Desenvolvimento FrontEnd e Digital Analytics.
  • Capacidade de traduzir desafios de negócios em requisitos técnicos claros.
  • Conhecimentos avançados em Google Analytics, Firebase, AppsFlyer, Google Ads, Facebook e outras plataformas de mídia.
  • Experiência avançada em arquitetura de dados e coleta de eventos (tagging/event tracking).


Desejável:

  • Conhecimentos em integração de dados em datalakes (GCP, BigQuery, AWS, S3).
  • Habilidade em análise de dados e criação de relatórios e dashboards.

Somos líder mundial em alianças do setor de bancasseguros e seguros de proteção de crédito, com presença em 33 países e posições fortes em três regiões: Europa, Ásia e América Latina. Com mais de 8.000 mil funcionários no mundo todo.


A BNP Paribas Cardif tem um papel essencial na vida dos clientes segurados, fornecendo soluções econômicas que permitem a realização de objetivos com a proteção contra eventos inesperados. Como uma empresa comprometida, a BNP Paribas Cardif se esforça para ter um impacto positivo na sociedade e contribuir para que os seguros sejam acessíveis ao maior número de pessoas possível.


No Brasil, somos uma das maiores especialistas em seguros massificados. Temos um portfólio de produtos diversificado, com destaque para: prestamista, garantia estendida (inclusive veicular), roubo e furto qualificado de portáveis com quebra acidental.


Somos uma seguradora B2B2C, ou seja, temos um modelo de negócio baseado em parcerias, em que nossos seguros são distribuídos para os clientes por meio da rede de grandes empresas brasileiras, divididas nos principais mercados: VAREJO, BANCOS e DIGITAL.


Venha trabalhar com a gente e vamos, juntos, tornar os seguros mais acessíveis à população brasileira!

title: Senior HRBP LATAM
description:
We're conducting a search for a Strategic Regional Talent Partner with 10+ years of progressive HR experience, an essential and proven focus on the Latin American (LATAM) region, and fluency in Portuguese and English with good verbal communication in Spanish.

This role works very closely with the C level (VP and Director level), influencing the business and translating business objectives into effective people and talent strategies. Will drive and implement global HR initiatives across key Latin American markets and addressing the unique challenges of the region.

This is a strategic and consultancy-focused role, dedicated to high-level partnering.


Key Areas of Accountability & Impact


The Strategic Regional Talent Partner is expected to drive results across three primary domains:


1. Strategic Business Partnership & Consulting


  • Executive Guidance: Serve as the primary HR advisor to senior regional executives, translating complex business objectives into actionable people plans
  • Performance Optimization: Provide expert counsel on maximizing business unit performance
  • Global Integration: Act as the regional conduit, collaborating with global Centers of Expertise (CoE) to ensure global people initiatives are effectively localized and deployed across LATAM markets.


2. Talent Management & Program Execution


  • High-Level Program Support: Directly advise and support senior leaders during critical annual organizational cycles
  • Capability Building: Partner with business leaders to identify and close critical skill gaps
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Facilitate the integration of talent programs across the business streams, working with cross-functional HR teams


3. Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement


  • Process Enhancement: Champion a continuous improvement mindset, actively soliciting feedback from the leadership population to refine HR processes and knowledge resources.
  • Service Model Efficiency: Effectively triage executive requests, leveraging a deep knowledge of the shared services model
  • Knowledge Leadership: Contribute to the overall organizational knowledge base and foster active knowledge sharing across the global HR community.


Required Experience, Skills, & Qualifications


Experience & Educational Foundation

  • Experience: 10+ years of progressive HR experience, with a minimum of 4+ years in a senior HR Business Partnering or strategic advisory role spanning multiple LATAM countries .
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field is highly desired.
  • Context: Proven ability to operate successfully within a complex, matrixed global organization utilizing an HR shared services delivery model.

Critical Competencies

  • Business Acumen: Possesses robust business knowledge (industry trends, competitors, market position)
  • Executive Influence: Exceptional ability to build trust, influence senior leaders (VP/Director), .
  • Bilingual Capability: Fluent English is mandatory. Proficiency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is highly desirable.
  • Agility & Judgment: Demonstrates high levels of resilience, adaptability, and critical thinking to navigate ambiguity, manage high-pressure situations, and exercise sound judgment.
  • Technical Familiarity: Experience with leading HRIS platforms (e.g., Workday ) and service management tools (e.g., ServiceNow ) is preferred.

Other Requirements

  • Flexibility: Willingness to accommodate business needs across different time zones (LATAM and North America).

title: FBS Sr Product Designer
description:
Our Client is one of the United States’ largest insurers, providing a wide range of insurance and financial services products with gross written premiums well over US$25 Billion (P&C). They proudly serve more than 10 million U.S. households with more than 19 million individual policies across all 50 states through the efforts of over 48,000 exclusive and independent agents and nearly 18,500 employees. Finally, our Client is part of one the largest Insurance Groups in the world.


About the Role

Farmers hiring a Senior User Experience (UX) Designer to join the Farmers Customer Experience Team, a multidisciplinary group that combines the power of human-centered and data-driven approaches to create end-to-end omni-channel experiences that enhance customer satisfaction, streamline operations, and deliver business impact.

This role drives strategic design by deeply understanding current user experiences, identifying opportunities, and envisioning future-state solutions. It leads the creation of effective user experiences through advanced UX principles and strategic thinking while independently delivering design solutions, collaborating with stakeholders, and contributing to evolving design systems.

The ideal candidate would have already achieved a senior level of UX and digital product design proficiency (including the associated tools, collaboration skills, and understanding of technology) and is now looking to grow by applying that experience strategically within the broader context of Customer Experience and Service Design.


Key Responsabilities


  • Plans and facilitates workshops and design sprints to establish alignment, understand business objectives, develop concepts, and chart strategic paths forward.
  • Contributes to user research efforts interviews, surveys, usability testing, A/B tests, and competitive evaluations to uncover behaviors, motivations, and pain points. Collaborates with Journey Owners and research teams to define target audiences and goals.
  • Maps user journeys, workflows, and service touchpoints to identify pain points and opportunities.
  • Applies insights to recommend UX improvements, validate decisions, and develop design concepts that balance user needs with business objectives.
  • Creates wireframes, mockups, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs to explore, communicate, and document solutions.
  • Tests and refines layouts, user interfaces, interaction patterns, and system components to ensure consistency and quality. Develops clear documentation and specifications to enable seamless implementation and guide development processes. Supports the evolution of design systems by evaluating and updating components to promote scalability and reusability.
  • Collaborates with product teams, development teams, and stakeholders to define requirements and co-create solutions. Participates in planning sessions and design reviews to facilitate implementation of features and functionality as designed.
  • Keeps stakeholders informed on goals, expectations, and timelines throughout the design process. Leads meetings effectively and presents with polish, using advanced storytelling and presentation skills to convey context, design concepts and rationale through a compelling narrative.
  • Conducts post-launch design evaluations to assess effectiveness of the design work, identify usability issues, recommend refinements, and measure impact.
  • Accepts and incorporates feedback to improve performance and work quality while knowing when to change direction or stay the course.
  • Seeks out opportunities to advance design skills by staying informed on trends, tools, and best practices in user experience. Actively explores and appropriately integrates AI tools into the design workflow.
  • Mentors less experienced team members to develop skills while providing feedback they seek and value.

Requirements

  • Minimum three years of experience required in user experience (UX) design, product design, or related field.
  • Bachelors degree preferred
  • Tools: Figma, Mural/Miro, Rally/Jira, Office Suite
  • Deep understanding of UX principles, usability, and product design.
  • Familiarity with customer journey mapping and service blueprinting.
  • Strong communication and facilitation skills; able to present ideas clearly and confidently.
  • Effective collaboration and conflict resolution abilities.
  • Excellent time management and project prioritization skills.
  • Experience with agile methodologies and product management practices.
  • Proficiency in design tools like Figma, Mural/Miro, and Microsoft Office.
  • Basic knowledge of front-end development concepts.
  • Strong storytelling and presentation capabilities.

Benefits

This position comes with competitive compensation and benefits package:

  1. Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
  2. Comprehensive benefits package
  3. Career development and training opportunities
  4. Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office-based)
  5. Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group
  6. Private Health Insurance
  7. Pension Plan
  8. Paid Time Off
  9. Training & Development

Work Environment:

The role typically requires working in an office environment, with the possibility of remote work depending on the organization’s policies. The Operations Manager may need to be available during peak hours to oversee operations and support staff.

title: Broadcast Specialist/Coordinator

title: Head of FP&A
description:
Sinch is looking for a talented Head of FP&A to join us in Sao Paulo! The Director will serve as a key strategic partner to the Senior Leadership Team in Latin America, leading the overall financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and performance analysis functions for the organization in Brazil. The Director will report to the VP of FP&A - Americas located in the United States.

This leadership role is responsible for translating business strategy into financial plans, providing data-driven insights to support critical decision-making, and driving operational efficiency and financial performance improvements. The Director will also be responsible for managing, mentoring, and developing a highly performing FP&A team.


Sinch is a global customer engagement platform that provides communication services for businesses across messaging, voice, and email. Sinch's services are used by more than 150,000 businesses, including many of the world's largest tech companies.


Responsibilities

Financial Analysis and Reporting:

  • Direct the preparation of timely, accurate, and insightful management reports (e.g., Monthly/Quarterly Business Review packages) for the Senior Leadership Team in LatAm
  • Conduct in-depth variance analysis on financial performance (Actuals vs. Budget/Forecast/Prior Year), identifying key trends, opportunities, and risks, and clearly articulating the 'story behind the numbers.'
  • Own and manage the reporting of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), ensuring metrics are relevant and drive accountability across the organization.
  • Collaborate with the Accounting and Controllership teams to ensure accurate financial data consolidation and reporting in compliance with local BR GAAP and international standards (e.g., IFRS/US GAAP, if applicable).
  • Prepare compelling financial presentations and reports for executive leadership, and other stakeholders


Strategic Planning, Budgeting, and Forecasting:

  • Lead the comprehensive annual planning (Budget) and long-range planning (LRP) processes for Latin America, primarily in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, ensuring alignment with corporate strategic goals.
  • Manage the quarterly financial forecasting process, incorporating business drivers, market trends, and operational changes to ensure high accuracy and predictability.
  • Develop complex financial models (e.g., scenario analysis, sensitivity analysis) to evaluate new business initiatives, and strategic projects.


Business Partnering and Stakeholder Management:

  • Act as the primary finance partner to the General Manager - LatAm and other functional leaders (Sales, Marketing, Operations), providing financial advice and challenging assumptions.
  • Present financial results, forecasts, and strategic recommendations clearly and persuasively to executive management.
  • Drive continuous improvement in cost management and resource allocation, recommending actions to optimize profitability and operational efficiency.


Team Leadership and Development:

  • Manage, coach, mentor, and motivate a team of FP&A professionals, fostering a culture of high performance, analytical rigor, and professional growth.
  • Define team goals, allocate resources efficiently, and manage workflows to ensure all deliverables are met accurately and on time.
  • Lead efforts to streamline and automate FP&A processes and systems to improve efficiency and data integrity.



Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field. MBA degree highly desirable.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in financial planning and analysis (FP&A), public accounting, investment banking, or private equity; with a strong focus on operational expenses, and preferably with a large multinational corporation.
  • A minimum of 3+ years of experience managing a team of financial professionals.
  • Experience with financial planning and reporting software (Anaplan, AARO), ERP systems, CRM systems (Salesforce), and Visual Reporting (Tableau) highly preferred.
  • Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills
  • Proven ability to synthesize complex financial data into clear and concise insights for non-financial stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships across the organization.
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Previous experience in finance within a technology or telecommunications environment would be advantageous
  • Fluency in English (verbal and written) is required for effective communication with international leadership.
  • Fluency in Spanish desirable but not required.

title: Analista de processos
description:
Venha para uma das maiores empresas de Serviços TI do mundo!! Aqui você pode transformar sua carreira! Por que fazer parte da TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, por isso vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado cheio de oportunidades de melhorias e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias através das ferramentas certas, contribuindo para nosso sucesso num ambiente colaborativo.


Sobre o Papel:

Procuramos Analista de Processos Sênior que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira.


Principais Responsabilidades:


●Diagnóstico e Mapeamento (As-Is): Conduzir entrevistas, workshops e sessões de observação com stakeholders para um levantamento detalhado dos processos atuais.

●Análise Crítica: Analisar os processos mapeados para identificar gargalos, restrições, dependências, ineficiências, redundâncias, retrabalho e pontos de falha que impactam a performance e a qualidade.

●Investigação de Causa Raiz: Aplicar técnicas estruturadas (como Diagrama de Ishikawa, 5 Porquês) para diagnosticar a origem dos problemas identificados, indo além dos sintomas.

●Desenho e Modelagem (To-Be): Projetar processos futuros, otimizados e alinhados às melhores práticas, utilizando notações padrão de mercado (ex: BPMN) para garantir clareza e consistência.

●Definição e Validação: Definir o escopo, os objetivos e as métricas de sucesso para iniciativas de melhoria, validando as soluções propostas com as áreas de negócio e garantindo o alinhamento estratégico.

●Documentação e Gestão do Conhecimento: Criar e manter a documentação técnica dos processos, incluindo fluxogramas, manuais, e regras de negócio, servindo como uma base de conhecimento para a organização.


Competências Técnicas :


●Domínio de BPM: Sólida experiência com as práticas e disciplinas do BPM (Business Process Management), tendo como referência o guia BPM CBOK.

●Técnicas de Levantamento: Proficiência em conduzir entrevistas, observar operações e facilitar workshops para coletar requisitos e mapear processos de forma precisa.

●Análise de Processos: Habilidade comprovada para analisar fluxos de trabalho, identificando dores, problemas de qualidade, riscos, não conformidades e oportunidades de melhoria.

●Modelagem de Processos: Experiência prática na criação de diagramas de processo (fluxogramas) e na documentação de atividades, tarefas e pontos de decisão.

●Resolução de Problemas: Capacidade de questionar e investigar as razões por trás de atrasos e ineficiências, aplicando uma abordagem analítica e estruturada.


Certificações (Desejável):

Certificação relevante na área, como CBPP® (Certified Business Process Professional) da ABPMP, ou similar.


Diferenciais:

●Experiência do Usuário: Vivência com metodologias de Design Thinking e desenho de jornada do usuário para criar processos centrados nas necessidades do cliente e do colaborador.

●Arquitetura de Negócios: Conhecimento em frameworks como TOGAF ou BIZBOK (BA GUILD) para garantir o alinhamento dos processos com a estratégia corporativa.

●Arquitetura e Modelagem de Dados: Noções de Análise e Modelagem Conceitual de Dados, tendo como referência o DAMA DMBOK, para entender como os dados suportam e são gerados pelos processos.


Formação: Superior em Administração, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas..


Pós-Graduação/Certificação Avançada: Pelo menos uma pós-graduação, MBA ou uma certificação avançada (ex: Black Belt em Lean Six Sigma, certificações avançadas em Arquitetura de Negócios ou Processos).

title: Development (Fundraiser) Officer
description:
The Development (Fundraiser) Officer will be responsible for mapping and applying for the possible grants and sponsorships from government laws, planning, organizing, and executing fundraising initiatives to support the mission and strategic goals of EARJ. This role requires a strong communicator with experience in data keeping and administration as well as event planning . The Officer will also work closely with the school leadership to implement effective development campaigns, foster a culture of giving, and increase community engagement.


Responsibilities:

  • Fundraising Strategy: Assist in developing and implementing a comprehensive annual fundraising plan to meet the school’s financial and development goals.
  • Campaigns & Events: Organize and coordinate fundraising events, campaigns, and initiatives, such as capital campaigns, online giving drives, auction evenings, and alumni engagement events.
  • Donor Relations: Cultivate and maintain relationships with potential and current donors, sponsors, and partners. Develop and implement donor recognition programs.
  • Research, identify, and apply for grants and sponsorship opportunities that align with the school’s mission (Ex: “Lei de incentivo ao esporte”).
  • Alumni Engagement: Work with alumni to foster lifelong connections to the school and to encourage giving.
  • Marketing & Communications: Collaborate with the marketing team to create compelling fundraising content, including newsletters, social media posts, and donor appeals.
  • Reporting & Data Management: Maintain accurate records of fundraising activities, donor contributions, and financial reports. Provide regular updates on fundraising progress to leadership.
  • Budget Management: Track and manage the fundraising budget, ensuring cost-effective planning and execution of events and initiatives.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, or a related field.
  • English fluency is essential for this position, as communication with international stakeholders will be a core part of the role.

title: Consultor de Suprimentos
description:
RESUMO DO CARGO


O Consultor de Suprimentos é responsável por liderar estrategicamente a gestão de uma ou mais categorias de compras, garantindo o alinhamento com os objetivos da empresa e o cumprimento das políticas internas. Atua de forma transversal com diversas áreas, sendo responsável por desenvolver, implementar e otimizar estratégias de suprimentos que maximizem valor, assegurem qualidade e promovam sustentabilidade.

  • Estabelecer e monitorar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) da categoria, promovendo ações de melhoria contínua.
  • Avaliar e acompanhar o desempenho de fornecedores com base em critérios técnicos, comerciais e de conformidade.
  • Garantir que todos os processos de compras estejam em conformidade com normas e certificações aplicáveis (como ISO, FSSC, SOX, entre outras).
  • Atuar como ponto focal para temas relacionados à sua categoria, representando a área em fóruns técnicos e reuniões multidisciplinares.
  • Apoiar o processo orçamentário da área, definindo premissas de custo e realizando análises gerenciais.
  • Liderar iniciativas de otimização de processos, buscando eficiência operacional e automação via sistemas ERP.
  • Suportar auditorias internas e externas, bem como interações com áreas jurídicas, financeiras e de compliance.
  • Zelar pelo alinhamento às políticas corporativas de ética, sustentabilidade, segurança, meio ambiente e qualidade.


Pré-Requisitos


  • Superior Completo em Administração, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Idioma: Inglês Avançado
  • Liderança em demandas complexas
  • Sólida experiência em compras em gestão de categorias

  • Conhecimento em SAP
  • Conhecimento em MS Office
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.



Sobre a Ardagh

A Ardagh Metal Packaging (AMP) é uma das líderes globais na produção e venda de embalagens de alumínio para bebidas, com 3 unidades de produção no Brasil - fábricas de latas em Jacareí (SP) e Alagoinhas (BA) e uma fábrica de tampas de Manaus (AM) – e um escritório localizado em São Paulo. Globalmente, a AMP opera 24 instalações de produção nas Américas e Europa, empregando cerca de 5.800 funcionários e registrou receitas de US $ 4 bilhões em 2021. A inclusão, confiança, trabalho em equipe e excelência são nossos valores e junto com o talento que buscamos, serão a fórmula perfeita para crescermos juntos!


Somos apaixonados por sustentabilidade e temos uma ótima reputação pela inovação e qualidade que oferecemos a nossos clientes. Nós somos pioneiros em novos métodos de produção, novas técnicas de design e novas formas de reciclar e economizar energia. Nosso objetivo é reduzir os impactos ambientais, enquanto permanecemos economicamente sustentáveis e socialmente responsáveis.


Na Ardagh, temos a consciência da singularidade de cada ser humano. Valorizamos e respeitamos a diversidade da nossa rede de colaboradores. Aqui, você pode ser você, contribuindo com suas experiências para o nosso negócio. Afinal, cada um é um mundo, e, na Ardagh, todo mundo importa! Gostou? #VEM ser você :)



Se seu perfil corresponde à vaga, candidate-se a essa posição e #VEMserLateiroAMP.

title: Hardware Test & Verification Designer
description:
At TOPIC (in the Netherlands ) we work every day on high-tech innovations to make the world smarter, healthier, and better. Are you a highly driven and ambitious Hardware Test & Verification Designer

with a passion for designing, developing, and executing cutting-edge hardware testing, and ready to make a real impact on product quality and innovation?


“There is a lot of flexibility to educate yourself.”


Gijs van Esch I Hardware Engineer at TOPIC Embedded Systems


What will you do as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer?

As a Hardware Test & Verification Designer you are responsible for designing, developing, and executing hardware testing and validation for complex embedded systems. Applies strong electronics knowledge (schematics, PCB design, signal behavior) to optimize performance and identify issues. Develops and maintains automated test scripts (Python required; LabVIEW, TestStand, or C/C++ preferred) and conducts HIL, reliability, and environmental testing.


Your responsibilities as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer:

  • Design, develop, and execute hardware testing, validation, and verification activities for embedded systems, ensuring product reliability and compliance;
  • Apply a solid understanding of electronics, schematics, PCB design, and signal behavior to identify potential issues and optimize hardware performance;
  • Conduct and support HIL (Hardware-in-the-Loop) testing, as well as reliability and environmental qualification testing;
  • Collaborate closely with embedded software and firmware teams; a hands-on programming mindset is preferred;
  • Work in a structured, plan-oriented manner, maintaining high accuracy in documentation, traceability, and reporting;
  • Take a consultative approach, translating test results into clear and valuable recommendations for design improvements and product optimization;
  • Act as a technical consultant, capable of operating across different customer environments to ensure quality, robustness, and regulatory compliance of embedded hardware products.


What do we offer you?

This will make you smarter:

  • Strategic projects in complex high-tech environments
  • Collaborate with other senior engineers and domain experts
  • Access to advanced training through our TOPIC Academy
  • Contribute to and lead tech events and knowledge sessions


This will make you better:

  • Permanent contract
  • An all-in benefits package (€62.000 – €82.000 annually) including 13th month, mobility, pension, extra holidays
  • 26 vacation days (option to buy extra), pension scheme, relocation support


This will keep you healthy:

  • Good work-life balance, flexible hours, and hybrid working
  • Inspiring office with daily fresh fruit and a gym
  • Home office support for an inspiring work-from-home setup
  • Regular fun, social, and sports events


What do you bring as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer?

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, or a related technical field;
  • 5+ years in hardware testing, validation, and verification;
  • Strong understanding of electronics, schematics, PCB design, and signal behavior;
  • Proficient in Python (required); experience with LabVIEW, TestStand, or C/C++ is a plus;
  • Familiarity with HIL testing, reliability testing, and environmental testing;
  • Affinity with embedded software and firmware; hands-on programming skills are preferred;
  • Plan-oriented and accurate, with strong skills in documentation, traceability, and reporting;
  • Able to interpret test results and translate them into actionable recommendations;
  • Comfortable acting as a technical consultant across various customer environments, ensuring the quality, reliability, and compliance of embedded hardware products;
  • A good command of English, and preferably Dutch language.


Our organization

Since 1996 we have been developing (embedded) systems that are essential for products manufactured by renowned high-tech companies around the world. Our projects involve edge to cloud solutions; from PCB design and FPGA to low level embedded software and application software for UI, Web, Mobile and cloud. We are well known for our high level of knowledge and expertise and are proud to be a Premier Embedded Computing Partner of AMD; technology leader in the field of System-on-Chips and FPGAs.


Diversity & Inclusion

At TOPIC, we believe that true innovation happens when people with different backgrounds, ideas, and perspectives come together. Every talent counts, and every voice matters. Diversity strengthens our creativity, and inclusion ensures that everyone feels welcome and valued. We build a culture where everyone has the space to contribute and be themselves.

title: Operation Strategy
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to transform food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage.

In less than one year, Keeta became an industry leader in Hong Kong, China. Soon after, we expanded into Saudi Arabia and are now present in more than 20 cities. Following our recent successful launch in Qatar, Kuwait and the UAE, we're bringing that same speed and innovation to more of the Middle East, and to Brazil.


Job Responsibilities

  1. Strategy Formulation: Based on the characteristics of SMB and SAKA business structures, clarify strategies around different dimensions such as merchant basic information, review, and menus; identify key indicators, key initiatives, and implementation paths to ensure strategy feasibility.
  2. Strategy Implementation: Transform strategies into practical approaches suitable for frontline teams, rationally break down objectives, assign them to specific individuals and actions; coordinate resources to resolve key bottlenecks, ensuring strategies truly drive team members to achieve business goals. Coordinate and resolve cross-departmental collaboration and execution obstacles to ensure efficient implementation and a closed-loop process at each key stage.
  3. Strategy Evaluation and Iteration: Evaluate strategy effectiveness through data review and performance evaluation; propose adjustments to inefficient processes, forming a closed-loop strategy iteration system to continuously optimize city-level business.
  4. Resource and Tool Development: Develop SOPs for the entire business process. Create exclusive sales scripts, brand service reports, and case studies for chain merchants, forming replicable and efficient signing and closing strategies.
  5. Performance Scheme Development: Utilize data as a management tool to participate in the development of performance evaluation schemes for each module. Performance and incentives: Address sales momentum. Based on the goals at different stages, design new contract performance and incentive programs to stimulate sales momentum and drive efficient achievement of targets.


Job Requirements

  1. Education Background: Bachelor's degree or above.
  2. Work Experience: (Hard Requirements) At least 3 years of relevant work experience in the internet industry; (Hard Requirements) Familiarity with sales processes and rhythms, experience in strategy development and incentive mechanism design; experience in e-commerce or food delivery industry is preferred.
  3. Skills and Analytical Abilities: Possess clear logical thinking ability; (Hard Requirements) Familiarity with SQL and common business analysis methods, strong data sensitivity, and ability to independently analyze business problems and propose optimization suggestions.
  4. Project Management Ability: Ability to independently manage projects from initiation to completion.
  5. Collaboration Ability: Ability to efficiently coordinate internal and external teams, drive the execution of complex projects, and ensure timely completion of tasks.
  6. Language Requirements: (Hard Requirements) English CET-6 or above. A strong command of English is a plus.

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a bold vision and innovative spirit. title: Analista de gerenciamento de dados
description:
Venha para uma das maiores empresas de Serviços TI do mundo!! Aqui você pode transformar sua carreira! Por que fazer parte da TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, por isso vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado cheio de oportunidades de melhorias e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias através das ferramentas certas, contribuindo para nosso sucesso num ambiente colaborativo.


Sobre o Papel:

Procuramos Analista Governança/Gerenciamento de Dados que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira.


Principais Responsabilidades:

●Implementação e Melhoria Contínua: Desenvolver, implementar e otimizar processos, políticas e padrões de governança de dados, assegurando sua aplicação em projetos e na operação diária.

●Framework DAMA-DMBOK: Aplicar as melhores práticas e áreas de conhecimento do DAMA-DMBOK para estruturar a gestão de dados corporativos de forma eficaz.

●Conformidade e LGPD: Garantir a conformidade dos processos de tratamento de dados com a Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD) e outras regulamentações aplicáveis, atuando na identificação e mitigação de riscos.

●Qualidade de Dados (Data Quality): Definir, monitorar e gerenciar métricas e regras de qualidade de dados, liderando iniciativas para correção e prevenção de inconsistências.

●Modelagem de Dados: Colaborar na criação e manutenção de modelos de dados (relacional e multidimensional), garantindo que o design atenda aos padrões de governança.

●Ferramentas de Governança: Gerenciar e operar soluções de catálogo de dados, integração e linhagem (Data Lineage) para proporcionar transparência e rastreabilidade.

●Gestão de Metadados: Estruturar e gerenciar o repositório de metadados técnicos e de negócio.

●Suporte a Projetos: Atuar como ponto focal de Governança de Dados em projetos de TI, orientando as equipes sobre os requisitos e padrões a serem seguidos.



Competências Técnicas :

●Domínio Estratégico do DAMA-DMBOK: Capacidade de definir a estratégia de governança de uma organização com base no framework, atuando como referência (SME).

●Arquitetura de Dados: Capacidade de liderar a definição da arquitetura de dados sob a ótica da governança, influenciando o design de soluções transacionais e analíticas.

●LGPD: Atuação como referência (SME) em projetos de adequação à LGPD, definindo políticas e processos complexos.

●Estratégia de Ferramentas: Experiência em definir a estratégia, arquitetura e liderar a implementação de plataformas de governança de dados (Catálogo, Qualidade, Linhagem).

●Cloud: Experiência prática com serviços de dados e governança nas principais nuvens (Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, Oracle Cloud).

●Metodologias: Conhecimento prático em DevSecOps aplicado a pipelines de dados e metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).


Certificações (Desejável):

●Certificação: Mínimo de uma certificação relevante para a área, como:

○DAMA CDMP (nível Associate ou Practitioner)

○Certificações de ferramentas específicas (ex: Informatica, Collibra) no nível fundamental

Diferenciais:


●Conhecimento avançado ou experiência como administrador na ferramenta INFORMATICA, especialmente nos módulos CDGC (Cloud Data Governance and Catalog).

●Experiência com soluções analíticas e plataformas de Big Data.

●Experiência prévia em setores com alta regulamentação de dados (financeiro, saúde, etc.).

●Inglês avançado ou fluente.


Formação: Superior completa e comprovada em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas.

Pós-Graduação/MBA: Pelo menos uma Pós-Graduação, MBA ou certificação de nível avançado/expert relacionada à Gestão, Arquitetura ou Governança de Dados.

title: IATF Auditor
description:
Job Title: IATF Auditor

Location: Sao Paulo, Brazil.


About the Role:

Are you a detail-oriented and proactive auditor with a passion for driving excellence in the automotive industry? At BSI, we’re looking for an IATF Auditor to join our dedicated team. This is a dynamic role where you’ll have the opportunity to apply your industry expertise to deliver high-quality audit services and contribute to the success of our clients' automotive supply chains.


Join a company where diversity, inclusion, and growth are at the heart of everything we do. If you’re ready to take the next step in your career and make a global impact, we’d love to hear from you!


In your day to day, you will be responsible for:

  • IATF Audit Leadership: Conduct comprehensive IATF audits to evaluate automotive manufacturing processes, risk management, and performance standards. Identify opportunities for improvement based on audit findings.
  • Customer-Centric Process Evaluation: Utilize your industry knowledge to assess organizations’ alignment with customer-specific requirements, ensuring the organization’s processes meet OEM expectations.
  • Data Analysis & Decision-Making: Collect, analyze, and synthesize audit data, drawing accurate conclusions on the effectiveness of management systems and corrective actions.
  • Statistical Process Control Expertise: Audit the application of SPC tools in manufacturing, understand process stability, and contribute insights to ensure manufacturing processes remain in control.
  • FMEA Expertise: Analyze and audit Failure Mode Effect Analysis (FMEA) processes, both design and process variants, to ensure product/process design aligns with industry standards.
  • Measuring System Analysis (MSA): Guide organizations on the effective application of MSA, ensuring accurate and reliable measurements to maintain quality standards.
  • IATF Compliance and Best Practices: Ensure the organization’s management system is IATF compliant, identifying potential system weaknesses and auditing accordingly.
  • Rule Enforcement: Stay up to date with the latest IATF standards and rules, identifying non-compliance, and ensuring immediate corrective action.


To be successful in the role, you will have:

  • Proven Expertise: In-depth knowledge of IATF 16949, ISO 9001, and other relevant industry standards.
  • Relevant Experience: At least 5 years of experience in manufacturing or industrial engineering within the automotive supply chain. At least 2 years of experience in Quality Management, ideally with direct exposure to IATF OEM clients.
  • Analytical Thinking: Ability to synthesize and analyze data to drive informed decision-making.
  • Effective Communication: Strong listening, speaking, and writing skills to collaborate effectively with teams and clients.
  • Persuasive & Influential: Ability to persuade and influence stakeholders to embrace corrective actions and improvements.
  • Adaptability: Comfort with active learning, adapting to new auditing techniques, and applying them to real-world scenarios.
  • Language Proficiency: Fluent in English.
  • Travel Requirements: This position requires 100% travel to client locations (domestic and international), including land and air travel.


Why BSI?

At BSI, we believe in delivering excellence worldwide, empowering individuals, and fostering a culture of collaboration and inclusion. As an IATF Auditor, you’ll play a critical role in shaping the future of automotive manufacturing standards and process optimization. Here’s what we offer:

  • Competitive Salary & Benefits
  • Flexible Working Arrangements
  • Career Growth & Development Opportunities
  • A Global, Inclusive Team Environment


Salary Range:

Competitive salary based on experience, location, and qualifications.


Diversity & Inclusion:

BSI is committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered and valued. We celebrate diversity and encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply.


Accommodations:

If you need any accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know. We are here to support you every step of the way.


Ready to join our team?

If you’re passionate about quality, process improvement, and working in a dynamic, globally recognized company, apply now and become a part of BSI's legacy of excellence.

description:
Na Deloitte, buscamos pessoas que queiram gerar impactos positivos todos os dias.   • Contribuir na produção de RPAs (desenvolvimento, implantação e sustentação) e tecnologia cognitiva (AI/GenAI), aplicando metodologia e técnicas adequadas, visando atender aos objetivos estabelecidos quanto à qualidade, custos, prazos e benefícios:
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhorias e automações de processos, elaborando diagnósticos com avaliações e recomendações para RPA e cognitivo, de forma a direcionar soluções adequadas as particularidades de cada grupo de unidades de negócio;
  • Avaliar detalhadamente e documentar processos;
  • Testar e validar a automação junto aos usuários, detectando possíveis desvios e realizando as correções necessárias;
  • Realizar operação assistida e transferência de conhecimento ao time de suporte;
  • Gerar manual de operação;
  • Rastrear defeitos e mal funcionamento via (Orquestrador Uipath, Automation Anywhere e chamados), e comunicar às equipes para resolução;
  • Executar pesquisas com usuários e testes de usabilidade
  • Desenvolver a solução conforme as boas práticas e controles;
  • Identificar necessidades de padronização de entradas de demandas;
  • Avaliar o ciclo de vida da automação proposta (sistemas envolvidos, versionamento, fase-out de sistemas e serviços);


Acreditamos na força dos talentos que preparamos. Eles transformam de fato, impactam organizações, impulsionam mais talentos e criam oportunidades. Que tal fazer parte da maior organização de serviços profissionais do mundo? Escolha seu impacto.

Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Ensinso Superior Completo nos cursos de Tecnologia;
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas RPA, especialmente UiPath ou Automation Anywhere (nível desenvolvedor).
  • Conhecimento intermediário em Python, voltado para automações simples (com bibliotecas como Selenium, PyAutoGUI, PyWinAuto etc.).
  • Conhecimentos em VBA e manipulação de arquivos (Excel, TXT, CSV, PDF).
  • Conhecimentos em interpretação e elaboração de diagramas UML e modelagem de processos em BPMN (desejável).
  • Conhecimento intermediário em bancos de dados relacionais: SQL, consultas, triggers, procedures (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle).
  • Experiência com consumo de APIs REST/SOAP (com ferramentas como Postman ou por código).
  • Familiaridade com HTML, XML, e conceitos de integração de sistemas.
  • Possuir experiência em projetos de consultoria em gestão por processos (modelagem de processos; técnicas de melhoria de processos; e modelos e ferramentas de gestão).
  • Desejável: conhecimentos iniciais de .NET ou Java.

Benefícios:

O que estará disponível para você?


Desenvolvimento profissional


É claro que cuidaríamos do seu desenvolvimento aqui na Deloitte! Queremos que você alcance seus objetivos profissionais e pessoais e, por isso, contamos com Universidade Corporativa, acesso a plataformas online de aprendizado, plataforma de idiomas com mais de 7.500 conteúdos e cerca de 60 cursos divididos por nível, área de atuação, habilidades profissionais e interesses, e até uma plataforma que reúne diversas instituições de ensino, fornecendo descontos exclusivos para profissionais Deloitte e seus dependentes.


Além disso, oferecemos um plano de carreira estruturado, com mentoria de profissionais da Deloitte por meio de um(a) coach, que poderá ouvir seus desafios e apoiar para que consiga evoluir tanto com habilidades técnicas, quanto com habilidades comportamentais com base na própria experiência. É ótimo ter uma pessoa mentora, não é mesmo?


Cuidados com o seu bem-estar


Aqui na Deloitte, acreditamos que saúde e bem-estar não são apenas projetos, e sim uma mudança de cultura. Queremos que você coloque em prática todo o seu talento e desenvolva uma carreira de sucesso com a gente, com equilíbrio entre Mente, Corpo e Propósito. Para isso, contamos com mais de 30 benefícios, como:

  • Serviço de telemedicina para que você consiga fazer uma pré-avaliação sem precisar sair de casa!
  • Family Strategy: programa destinados à profissionais gestantes e futuros papais que terão todo apoio possível neste momento tão especial
  • Wellhub (Gympass) para colocar os exercícios físicos em dia
  • Dia de folga no mês do seu aniversário, para celebrar uma das pessoas mais importantes de sua vida
  • Canal de apoio psicológico e Serviço Social


(Mais) Benefícios

  • Assistência médica e odontológica! Para que você faça check-ups e cuide de você, em primeiro lugar*
  • Participação nos lucros. Afinal, sem os nossos talentos, não poderíamos crescer exponencialmente
  • Auxílio-internet, para apoiar no trabalho em modelo híbrido
  • Seguro de vida
  • Cartão Multibenefícios*


*Você receberá um valor em seu cartão e poderá distribuí-lo entre as opções que melhor se adequam às suas necessidades de acordo com as regras do programa.




Oportunidade de fazer parte de uma cultura inclusiva na Deloitte Brasil

Essa posição de alta gerência terá papel fundamental na qualificação de leads inbound e outbound, garantindo a performance da etapa inicial do funil de novos negócios e promovendo alinhamento estratégico com os times de Vendas e Marketing!!!


O que você irá fazer:

  • Liderar a operação nacional de Pré-Vendas Mid Market, com gestão direta de coordenadores responsáveis por squads de SDRs;
  • Garantir a qualificação eficiente de leads inbound e outbound de perfil high ticket, respeitando os SLAs e critérios estabelecidos para cada canal;
  • Conduzir reuniões de alinhamento com áreas correlatas, como Vendas, Marketing e Produto, assegurando sinergia entre as etapas do funil comercial;
  • Acompanhar e evoluir os principais indicadores da área, como número de leads qualificados (com proposta comercial apresentada), taxa de conversão, SLA de atendimento, e performance e engajamento dos squads de Pré-Vendas (SDRs);
  • Liderar o desenvolvimento, execução e melhoria contínua dos playbooks de Pré-Vendas, em consonância com a estratégia comercial da companhia;
  • Supervisionar a estruturação de squads por segmento de mercado, porte de empresa ou canal de aquisição, promovendo especialização e eficiência;
  • Atuar como guardião da excelência operacional, garantindo previsibilidade, escalabilidade e eficiência no topo do funil de vendas;
  • Promover a capacitação contínua dos Coordenadores de Pré-Vendas e SDRs, reforçando a cultura de resultados, aprendizado e protagonismo;
  • Trabalhar com base em dados, conduzindo análises, diagnósticos e planos de ação voltados à melhoria de performance da área;
  • Representar a estrutura de Pré-Vendas em fóruns executivos, com reporting direto à Diretoria de Novos Negócios.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Graduação completa, sem restrição de área;

  • Vivência em empresas de tecnologia, SaaS ou serviços B2B com foco em performance comercial;
  • Histórico de entregas consistentes em ambientes de crescimento acelerado e alta exigência por previsibilidade;
  • Experiência com geração e qualificação de leads para vendas de longo ciclo e grande complexidade.
